question: How many moon arts are there in total and which pair concludes this enumeration?
premises: The enumeration of moon arts is being completed.
Tuṣṭi and Amṛta are named together.
inference: Including Tuṣṭi and Amṛta, the moon has sixteen arts in all.
plain_english: Likewise Tuṣṭi and Amṛta; indeed the arts of the moon are sixteen.
